assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness consistent with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is indicated
The service is for continuous rhythm assessment to correlate symptomatic events with underlying arrhythmias and optimize rate control management
The service addresses the clinical need for ongoing monitoring of documented paroxysmal atrial fibrillation episodes
